title: Narrative curves & simulated readers
authority: Author annotations and subjective reader feedback remain separate from manuscript facts and literary scores.
roughWarning: Local rough signals, not a semantic emotion model or literary score. Dialogue density and conflict words can be misleading; inspect evidence and add your own judgment.
overlayWarning: At most four characters and four plotlines. Character signals describe nearby text, not a proven inner state. Planned milestones are never treated as observed events.
localDone: Local analysis saved. No AI request was made.
tensionScale: 0–10 rough tension cues. Gaps mean unknown, not zero. Click the curve to inspect a chapter.
emotionScale: 0–10 tone cues: lower is more negative, higher more positive. This is not emotional depth.
emptyCurve: No manuscript yet. Write or import a chapter, then analyze it here.
staleOverride: The text or overlay definition changed. This older annotation is kept, but is not plotted as a current judgment.
methodFormula: Tension = clamp(0,10, conflict markers × 1000/max(100,characters) × 0.9 + Chinese dialogue ratio × 2 − calm markers × density × 0.25). Tone uses explicit positive/negative markers. No semantic reasoning or quality judgment is performed.
noEvidence: No verifiable signal evidence in this chapter or scope.
overrideHelp: These values override the displayed curve for this text version only. They do not change the local measurement, manuscript, Canon or State. Leave a value blank to keep the local value.
flatWarning: A pacing reminder only. Quiet chapters can be intentional and valuable. Only consecutive known points strictly below the threshold qualify; unknown gaps break a span.
noFlat: No qualifying span in the current analyzed range.
simulationWarning: Model simulation, not real reader data, sales prediction or an objective literary score. Age and payment willingness are author-defined assumptions.
emptyPersonas: Create a fictional reader profile to explore a reading perspective. No AI is needed to manage profiles.
maxCalls: Maximum AI requests in this batch
maxCallsHelp: Includes retries. The application never raises this limit or switches providers automatically.
offlineReaders: Profiles and history remain available offline. Generating reactions requires the model you select; unavailable services return a clear error without switching to Codex.
independentChunks: Each profile reads independent chunks of up to 8 consecutive chapters and 95,000 characters. Non-contiguous selections are separated. These results do not pretend to remember omitted or previous chunks.
readerWorking: Reader task running through the existing review system…
pausedAfterCurrent: No more readings will start automatically. The current task may finish.
frozenProfile: Profile version used in this batch
staleReport: The manuscript changed. This historical report is not a current-version reading.
unverifiedEvidence: This quote could not be verified; no location is claimed.
noReactions: The model returned no structured reactions. Do not infer a missing abandonment point or moving passage.
notRun: No completed model reading for this profile and chunk.
retryExplicit: Allow this reading to be retried
emptyHistory: No reader panels yet. Preview and confirm a scope when you are ready.
fictionalPersona: This is a fictional preference profile, not a real participant or a demographic claim.
removePersonaHelp: Remove “{{name}}” from the profile list? Existing reports retain their frozen profile and evidence.
unknownCost: Price unknown; check the provider’s billing
budgetCaveat: Token counts use UTF-8 bytes plus a per-request technique allowance, not a model tokenizer. Cost is a client estimate, not a bill or a provider spending limit. No AI starts until you approve and explicitly run the batch.
partialCoverage: PARTIAL COVERAGE: {{count}} selected chapters are unwritten, empty, too large or unavailable. They are not counted as read and are never silently truncated.
cannotApprove: No executable reading or request count exceeds your limit. Change the selection or explicitly create a new budget preview.
approveScopeBudget: Approve this exact scope and budget
approvedNotStarted: Scope and budget approved. No AI request has started; choose one reading or the approved batch.
unsavedEditor: You have unsaved narrative annotations or reader-profile edits.

status.SOURCE_CHANGED: Text or overlay changed; analyze again
status.CHARACTER_LOCAL_CONTEXT_NOT_INNER_STATE: Nearby character text, not inner state
status.NO_TRACK_MILESTONE: No milestone for this plotline in this chapter
status.PLANNED_NOT_MEASURED: Planned milestone; not an observed event
status.RUN_INPUT_BUDGET_REACHED: Not processed: total input budget reached
status.RUN_TIME_BUDGET_REACHED: Not processed: execution time budget reached

availability.ANTHOLOGY_SELECT_MEMBER: Open an individual anthology member to inspect its curves and reader profiles.
availability.AMBIGUOUS_CHAPTER_NUMBERS: Ambiguous chapter numbers; organize the catalog before choosing a manuscript.

scopeHelp: Only selected text from this project is used. Final manuscript takes precedence; a draft is used only when no Final exists. Other novels, hidden settings and documents are excluded.
partialAnalysis: This run reached its total input or time budget; {{count}} chapters remain unprocessed. Narrow the range and retry. Unprocessed chapters stay unknown.
partialLocalDone: Partial local analysis saved. Unprocessed chapters do not count as reviewed.
localBusy: Processing local analysis or annotations. Larger ranges may take a moment; chapters left beyond the run budget will be marked unprocessed.
operationBusy: Processing this operation. AI starts only after an explicit run request.
analyzeBeforeOverride: Analyze locally first to bind the current manuscript version. Author judgment remains available even if automatic signals are insufficient.
historyUnavailable: {{count}} saved panel records are unavailable. Other profiles and reports remain usable. Restore damaged records from a backup; no model is rerun automatically.
recoveredFromReport: Completion status was recovered from a matching local report. No model request was repeated.

readerErrors.REPORT_UNAVAILABLE: The completed report is missing, damaged or unavailable; this is not an unrun reading. Check backups or storage. A retry creates a new model request.
readerErrors.TASK_MISSING_INTERRUPTED: The original task is unavailable and no matching completed report exists. Marked interrupted; never resumed automatically.
readerErrors.TASK_FAILED: The reading failed. Explicit retry is available only within the approved request budget.
readerErrors.TASK_CANCELLED: This reading was cancelled. No automatic retry or further reading is started.
readerErrors.TASK_INTERRUPTED: The original task was interrupted. The manuscript has not been resent automatically.

sourceReason.UNWRITTEN_CHAPTER: Unwritten chapter: no text, not counted as read
sourceReason.EMPTY_MANUSCRIPT: Empty manuscript: not counted as read
sourceReason.CHAPTER_TOO_LARGE_FOR_READER_REVIEW: Exceeds the reading limit: not truncated; narrow the scope

curveCoverage: Whole-book line: {{known}} chapters with usable values, {{unknown}} unknown/unanalysed, {{total}} chapters total.
signalCounts: Local cues: conflict {{conflict}}, calm {{calm}}, positive {{positive}}, negative {{negative}}. Word cues do not prove story events.
readerSummaryUnknown: Summary inconclusive: no locatable source evidence was supplied. Only source-verified individual reactions are shown below.
readerEvidenceWithheld: Withheld {{findings}} reactions/findings and {{quotes}} quotations without locatable evidence. They are not treated as manuscript facts.
